result.topic_en: Notes on proving that the function ζ(s,x) satisfies no algebraic partial differential equation, a suggested proof of the non-bendability of surfaces via the equation ∂²ϑ/∂u∂v = Mϑ (citing Bianchi), and a pasted note on Cantor's normal form of ordinals with an attempt to prove the continuum has the second cardinality.
